title: Engineering Manager, Mobile Platform

description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Team

Fanatics Collect is a leading marketplace and platform for physical and digital collectibles, bringing together commerce, content, and community for collectors at massive scale. We are building high-quality, fan-first experiences and investing deeply in modern engineering, product, and design practices to support long-term growth.

 

Role Summary

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the Client Platform Team across iOS, Android, and Web for the Live and Collect apps. This role is responsible for people leadership, platform execution, operational excellence, and strong technical judgment across shared client infrastructure and engineering workflows.

The Client Platform Team owns shared client infrastructure, developer tooling, observability foundations, release systems, and cross-platform standards that enable product engineering teams to ship high-quality client experiences faster and more safely. Product engineering teams remain responsible for feature delivery and operational quality within their domains, while the platform team enables consistency, visibility, reliability, and scalable engineering practices across the organization.

This role partners closely with Product, Design, Engineering, QA, SRE/Infrastructure, and other cross-functional stakeholders to improve release reliability, client observability, developer productivity, and platform health across the Live and Collect ecosystem.

This role is expected to be technically engaged and hands-on with engineering workflows, architecture discussions, operational reviews, debugging, and development practices while remaining primarily focused on team leadership, execution, and organizational impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Manage, coach, and develop engineers working across iOS, Android, and Web client platforms

• Lead platform initiatives focused on developer productivity, release reliability, observability, shared tooling, and client platform health

• Establish clear expectations, priorities, ownership boundaries, and success metrics for the Client Platform Team

• Partner with engineering leadership to prioritize platform reliability, developer productivity, observability, and modernization investments alongside product delivery commitments

• Improve release-readiness processes, CI/CD health, PR validation quality, automated testing practices, and incident follow-through

title: Enterprise Sales Director - Health
description:
This is a fully remote opportunity.

Gradient AI :
Gradient AI is revolutionizing Group Health and P&C insurance with AI-powered solutions that help insurers predict risk more accurately, improve profitability, and automate underwriting and claims. Our SaaS platform taps into one of the industry’s largest data lakes-tens of millions of policies and claims-to deliver deep, actionable insights. Trusted by leading carriers, MGAs, TPAs, and self-insured employers, Gradient AI has grown rapidly since our founding in 2018. Backed by $56M in Series C funding, we're scaling fast-and it's an exciting time to join the team.
About the Role:
We are searching for a results-driven Enterprise Sales Director - Health to join our growing team and lead enterprise sales efforts across the health insurance ecosystem. This individual will own the full sales cycle, selling our AI-powered SaaS underwriting and analytics solutions to health insurance and benefits organizations. This role requires someone who understands the nuances the health insurance landscape and can credibly speak the language of underwriting, actuarial, and clinical leadership.
The ideal candidate brings deep relationships across the health insurance ecosystem and a proven track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals. They are equally comfortable presenting to a Chief Actuary and negotiating with key leadership across large enterprise organizations, and they thrive in a high-growth startup environment where they can build something meaningful.
How you will make an impact:

• Own and grow a pipeline of enterprise opportunities across the group health ecosystem through strategic prospecting, existing relationships, and referral networks

• Lead the full consultative sales cycle from discovery and needs assessment through solution design, ROI modeling, contract negotiation, and close-engaging underwriting, actuarial, and C-suite stakeholders throughout

• Craft compelling statements of work, pricing proposals, and executive-level business cases that clearly articulate Gradient AI ’s value to health plan and benefits decision-makers

• Develop deep domain expertise in AI-powered underwriting and stop loss analytics, and clearly communicate how our solutions drive loss ratio improvement, operational efficiency, and portfolio growth for health insurance clients

• Hit, achieve, and exceed monthly and annual sales targets; provide accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in CRM

Skills needed to succeed:

• Bachelor’s degree required; 10+ years of enterprise SaaS or technology sales experience, with at least 5 years selling into the health insurance space

• Demonstrated ability to build and close a book of business from scratch; a hunter mentality with proven quota attainment at or above 100%

• Strong negotiation and presentation skills; experience running technical demos and building ROI models tailored to health insurance and benefits stakeholders

• Prior experience navigating complex buying committees, including Chief Actuaries, CMOs, VPs of Underwriting, and CFOs at health carriers and benefits organizations; outstanding verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to work in a self-driven manner within a fast-paced, collaborative startup environment; comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action

What We Offer:

• A fun, team-oriented startup culture.

• Generous stock options - we all get to own a piece of what we’re building.

• Unlimited vacation days.

• Flexible schedule that supports working from home.

• Full benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid paternal leave, and more.

• Ample opportunities to learn and take on new responsibilities.

We are an equal opportunity employer.
OTE Range: The anticipated on-target earnings (OTE) for this position is $400,000 - $450,000 USD, inclusive of base salary with strong accelerators.
This role is also eligible for commission, equity grant and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Creative Strategist / Direct-Response Copywriter - Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Und du konzeptionierst die Videos, die den Account tragen.
Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Deine Creatives sollen ihn auf dem Weg zu einem neunstelligen supporten.
Aktuell schreibt eine Creative Strategist unsere Ads. Du kommst als zweite Kraft dazu: mit eigener Pipeline, eigenen Ideen und eigenen Ergebnissen. Vollzeit, 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Aufgaben
Kurzfassung: Du findest heraus, warum Menschen kaufen, und schreibst Videos, die genau das auslösen. Bis zum fertigen Creative im Account.

• Du sammelst Angles: aus Bewertungen, Kommentaren, Umfragen, unseren besten Ads und Swipes. KI hilft beim Research, den Gedanken dahinter hast du.

• Du schreibst komplette Skripte für Video-Ads: Hook, Body, CTA. Auf Deutsch (bald auch auf Englisch).

• Du organisierst den Content für dein Skript: UGC-Creator, Founder-Aufnahmen, B-Roll, Voiceover, Shotlisten.

• Du briefst den Cutter, gibst Feedback und nimmst ab.

• Du iterierst auf dem, was läuft: neue Hooks, neue Längen, neue Angles.

• Du führst deine eigene Pipeline vom Test bis zur Skalierung. Im Ads Manager siehst du, was sie bringt.

Qualifikation
Wir suchen jemanden, der Copy schreibt, die verkauft, und das belegen kann:

• Du hast Direct-Response-Copy geschrieben, die nachweislich Umsatz gebracht hat. Beispiele und Zahlen liegen bei dir bereit.

• Du kennst Meta-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld von innen und weißt, was ein Creative braucht, damit es verkauft.

• Idealerweise zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Creative Strategy oder Performance-Copywriting.

• Du denkst in Avataren, Awareness Stages und Mass Desires. Marketing-Psychologie ist für dich echtes Handwerk.

• KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Research, Varianten, Struktur. Der Hook, der sitzt, kommt von dir.

• Du schreibst verkaufsstark auf Deutsch und verhandlungssicher auf Englisch.

• Du hast Bock auf Output. Viele Videos, viele Tests, viele Learnings. Und die Geduld, zu wiederholen, was funktioniert.

• Nice-to-have: Advertorials, Listicles oder eigene Media-Buying-Erfahrung.

Benefits

• Ein Account, an dem deine Arbeit sichtbar wird: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Du siehst jeden Tag, was dein Skript bringt.

• Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: eigene Pipeline, eigene Entscheidungen.

• Klare Perspektive: Richtung Senior.

• Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen).

• 100 % Remote innerhalb Europas.

• Flexible Arbeitszeit: Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein. Was zählt, ist dein Output.

• Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

• Technik-Setup deiner Wahl.

• Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.

• Ehrliches Feedback, das dich schneller weiterbringt.

• Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann schick uns dein Portfolio.
Zeig uns Creatives und Skripte, die du geschrieben hast, gerne so viele wie möglich: für welche Marke, was dein Anteil war und was dabei rausgekommen ist (ROAS, Spend, Winrate). Geschwärzt ist völlig okay.
Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Portfolio, Zahlen, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB).
Wichtig: Wir schauen zuerst auf deine Arbeitsproben. Gute Copywriter erkennt man an ihrer Copy.
Ein Bild von uns und dem Team bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Tabea und das Valkental -Team freuen sich auf dich!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Manos OverviewManos Software Group is part of Valsoft Corporation , a long-term investor in vertical market software businesses. Valsoft acquires and operates software companies with a permanent ownership mindset, emphasizing autonomy, disciplined growth, and long-term value creation. Manos focuses on healthcare-adjacent verticals, including dental, medical, and veterinary software.
If you're technically strong, care about shipping quality software, and want your work to visibly move the product forward, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity
As a Software Developer, you'll design, build, and ship features across our platforms. You'll work closely with product owners, QA, and support to take well-scoped requirements from design through to production, and you'll have real input into how those requirements get shaped in the first place. We're rebuilding our engineering practices as we scale post-acquisition, so you'll help set the standard for code quality, review, and release process - not just follow one that's already fixed in stone.

What Success Looks Like
During your first year, you'll:

• Ship a meaningful body of production code across platforms.

• Build a track record of reliable, well-tested releases with minimal regressions.

• Partner effectively with product owners, QA, and support across the full SDLC.

• Debug and resolve production issues efficiently, with clear root-cause analysis.

• Contribute ideas that improve our engineering practices as we scale.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, test, and ship features across the platforms.

• Write clean, maintainable code and participate actively in code review.

• Debug and resolve production issues, partnering with support and QA as needed.

• Work closely with product owners to clarify requirements and flag technical tradeoffs early.

• Follow and help improve our SDLC practices (branching, review, release, QA).

• Participate in technical design discussions and architecture decisions for your area.

Why This Role Matters
Every feature our operators rely on - bookings, payments, waivers, reporting - is only as good as the engineering behind it. As we rebuild our product organization post-acquisition, the developers who join now will shape not just what gets built, but how reliably and how well it's built for years to come.

You'll Thrive Here If...

• You want ownership over how you solve a problem, not just a ticket to close.

• Accountability motivates you.

• You appreciate direct feedback because it helps you improve.

• You like experimenting, learning, and helping build better ways of working.

• You care as much about your teammates' success as your own.

• You want to help build something, not simply inherit it

Our Hiring Process
We believe hiring should be thoughtful, transparent, and fast. Our process typically includes:

• Introductory conversation

• Hiring manager interview

• Technical assessment / pairing exercise

• Leadership conversations

• Final decision

Join Us
We're building more than a codebase. We're building the engineering foundation that will define the next chapter of Clubspeed and Resova. If you're looking for a place where you'll be trusted with real ownership over your work, and rewarded for the outcomes you drive, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Deepgram is building its decision layer: one governed set of numbers that people and AI agents can act on without re-deriving them. This role builds it.

You are not building pipelines. Ingestion, orchestration and latency belong to the data platform team, and they're good at it. You take what lands in the warehouse and turn it into the layer above the conformed gold tables, the semantic models, and the agent-facing tools that let someone (or something) ask a question and get an answer that holds up.

This is a senior technical IC role on a new team. You'll be the first or second engineer in.

- Model the gold layer. Conformed entities for customer, account, project, product and contract. Our identity model spans Salesforce, the console, Stripe and the billing system, with no authoritative key between them resolving that is week one.

- Own the semantic layer. Author the models that define our metrics once, so a dashboard, a notebook and an agent all return the same number. Version them. Retire the superseded ones.

- Build the agent-facing surface. The tools, permissions and MCP surfaces that let analyst agents navigate our data without inventing a join that looks plausible and is wrong.

- Make correctness checkable. Assertions on the things that break silently grain, uniqueness, cross-system reconciliation routed to a named owner. Evaluation of agent output against known-correct answers, tracking accuracy, refusal, and confidently-wrong rates separately.

- Absorb the questions. Sales, product and finance bring real questions. You answer them, and you leave behind a model that makes the next version of that question cheaper.

- AI-native practice, demonstrated. You use AI daily and intricately not to autocomplete, but as a way of working that has changed what you attempt. We will ask what the most interesting thing you've built with AI in the last month is, and we'll go three questions deep on the answer.

• Hands-on experience with SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development.

• Solid experience with OData v2/v4 service design and consumption.

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

This role is remote, or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT.

Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, the Web Operations Manager is the operational engine of Vasion 's web team - the person who turns business requests into shipped pages and the person who keeps the team's delivery rhythm on track.

This role owns Vasion 's CMS day to day: building and editing pages and landing pages using existing components and templates, and knowing when a request can be handled directly versus when it needs to be scoped and handed to a developer or designer. This role also runs the team's operating cadence - standups, sprint planning, prioritization, and retros - and is the first stop for any stakeholder across Marketing who needs something from the web team. A big part of the job is translating a business ask ("we need a new campaign page," "this section needs to change") into a clear, actionable requirement someone can actually execute against, then following it through to done. • Maintain governance over templates, components, and design-system usage across the site so pages stay consistent as more people request changes

• Handle redirect management, URL governance, and the ongoing consolidation of Vasion 's multi-brand web footprint

• Monitor Core Web Vitals, site speed, uptime, and overall page performance, and flag/triage issues as they come up

• Run web team standups, sprint planning, prioritization meetings, and retros

• Serve as the first point of contact for any stakeholder engaging the web team - triage inbound requests and turn them into scoped roadmap items

• Coordinate QA, cross-browser testing, regression testing, and releases with the development team

• Support localization and multi-region site execution in partnership with content and regional marketing teams

Search & Conversion Execution

• Implement technical SEO and AEO/GEO content structuring on pages, based on strategy and priorities set by leadership

• Build, QA, and ship CRO tests defined in partnership with leadership

• Surface technical feasibility and constraints back to leadership to help

title: Embedded Control Engineer

WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion - Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters - Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

- Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

- Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

- Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

- You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

- You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

title: Implementation Lead
description:
About TJM Labs

TJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.
Pharmacies are being asked to do more with fewer resources. Prescription volumes are growing, margins are tightening, and talented pharmacy teams spend too much of their day on repetitive operational work.
We're changing that.
TJM Labs builds AI-powered automation designed specifically for pharmacy. Our technology works within the systems pharmacies already use to automate repetitive workflows and create more capacity for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to focus on the work that actually requires them.
We're growing quickly, and successful implementation is one of the most important parts of delivering on that promise.
That's where you come in.
About the Role
We're looking for an Implementation Lead to own the day-to-day execution of customer implementations from discovery through go-live and transition to ongoing support.
This is a hands-on role at the intersection of pharmacy operations, project management, customer communication, and technology.
You'll work in close partnership with a Customer Success Manager (CSM). The CSM owns the overall customer relationship, strategic alignment, and escalations. You own getting the implementation done.
During implementation, you'll be the hub of the project. You'll coordinate customer and internal stakeholders, document how the pharmacy operates today, translate those workflows into clear requirements, maintain the implementation plan, manage communication and action items, own internal QA, and drive the project toward a successful go-live.
You'll also own one of the most important safeguards in our implementation process: making sure what the pharmacy does, what we've documented, what we've asked our technical teams to build, and what we ultimately deliver all remain in sync.
This isn't a role where you'll simply maintain a project plan and schedule meetings.
You'll ask questions. You'll uncover exceptions. You'll document details. You'll chase down decisions. You'll test what we've built. You'll notice when something doesn't line up. You'll keep people accountable for commitments. And when a project starts drifting, you'll help get it back on course.
You don't need to be an engineer or an AI expert.
You do need to understand pharmacy operations and pharmacy management systems, be curious about technology, communicate exceptionally well, and be very good at turning complexity into clarity.
What You'll Own
1. Day-to-Day Implementation Execution
Once a customer enters implementation, you'll own the day-to-day work required to get them live.

• Establish and maintain the implementation plan, milestones, dependencies, and target go-live date.

• Lead implementation meetings, discovery sessions, and working sessions.

• Coordinate activities across the pharmacy, TJM technical teams, the CSM, and other internal stakeholders.

• Track decisions, action items, customer deliverables, risks, dependencies, and outstanding requirements.

• Follow up consistently to keep projects moving.

• Identify risks and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.

• Manage implementation changes and understand their impact on scope, requirements, and timelines.

• Keep projects on schedule and surface concerns before they become surprises.

• Coordinate go-live activities and the transition into ongoing support.

At any point in the project, you should be able to answer: What needs to happen next to get this customer live?
2. Pharmacy Process Discovery & Documentation
Before we can automate a pharmacy workflow, we need to understand exactly how that workflow operates today.
You'll own creating and maintaining clear, accurate, and highly standardized documentation of each customer's current-state pharmacy processes before TJM automation is introduced.

• Lead structured workflow discovery with pharmacy stakeholders.

• Understand how work moves through the pharmacy today - including people, pharmacy management systems, other te

title: Product Reliability Engineer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops silicon and system-level solutions designed for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. The team is responsible for building the next generation of AI-native silicon while working closely with software and research partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. In addition to delivering production-grade silicon for OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure, the team also creates custom design tools and methodologies that accelerate innovation and enable hardware optimized specifically for AI.

The Compute team works on the design of our AI supercomputers, doing everything from workload modeling to influencing accelerator design. We’re leaning into our partnerships to make system and data center co-design an integral part of this process, and are looking for engineers to design AI supercomputers solutions for data center applications

This team is responsible for working with partners to optimize their hardware for our workloads, identifying promising new deep learning accelerators, and bringing those hardware platforms to production.

If you’re excited to work at the intersection of cutting edge deep learning, hardware system, and data center design this role is for you!

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Reliability Engineer to own reliability engineering for advanced IT hardware, from printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) through compute and networking trays, systems, and fully integrated racks. You’ll translate operating conditions and service-life goals into reliability requirements, design and execute qualification tests, and drive failure analysis and corrective-action verification from development through production and field deployment. Working with electrical, mechanical, thermal, manufacturing, quality, and data center teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners, you’ll use test and field evidence to improve hardware durability, serviceability, and availability.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Define reliability requirements and targets for PCBAs, trays, systems, and racks using mission profiles, expected service life, operating environments, duty cycles, and availability goals.

- Drive design-for-reliability reviews with electrical, mechanical, and thermal engineers. Use failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA or FMEA) and physics of failure to prioritize risks and recommend design improvements. Own component de-rating guidelines and guidance.

- Own reliability qualification plans from new product introduction through production, defining test coverage, representative configurations, sample sizes, stress conditions, duration, pass/fail criteria, and exit evidence at each assembly level.

- Develop and execute accelerated life and environmental tests, including temperature cycling, humidity exposure, power cycling, shock, vibration, and transport testing. Exercise hardware under representative workloads and monitor function and degradation during stress.

- Analyze life-test and field data using Weibull and other reliability models, acceleration models, and confidence intervals. State assumptions, exposure, and uncertainty when estimating failure rates, useful life, or reliability against targets.

- Lead failure investigations from symptom reproduction through physical root cause. Maintain failure reporting, analysis, and corrective-action records, and verify fixes through targeted testing and recurrence monitoring.

- Review supplier reliability plans and evidence for PCBs, PCBa components/assemblies, cables, connectors, and cooling components. Identify gaps between component qualification and the stresses encountered in the integrated system or rack.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
Position Overview:
The Software Test Engineer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the overall quality of the Simr Platform, a web application that lets engineers run and manage their simulation workflows in the cloud. The platform has two main areas: the HPC side, where users run batch jobs and work in interactive sessions on HPC clusters, and the data side, where simulation results are ingested, processed, stored and made available for search, analysis and reporting through DataStudio, APIs and Jupyter notebooks.
While the role covers the platform as a whole, its main focus is the data side. The engineer is expected to understand the data workflows in depth, from simulation output files to queryable tables and reports, and to own their test planning, manual and automated testing, and data validation. Working closely with backend, data and frontend engineers, the engineer catches issues early and makes sure data features are released with confidence. The ideal candidate works independently on medium-complexity tasks, is comfortable with SQL and Python, and enjoys understanding how data moves through a modern, cloud-based system.
Responsibilities:

• Plan, design and execute test cases for the Simr Platform, with a focus on data ingestion, processing, storage and reporting features.

• Validate data end to end, from source files to what users see in the UI, APIs and reports, checking accuracy, completeness and consistency.

• Test core HPC workflows of the platform, such as batch job submission and interactive sessions, as part of regression and release testing.

• Use SQL and scripting to verify data and back-end behavior independently.

• Test REST APIs and asynchronous/background processes, including error handling, retries and permissions.

• Develop and maintain automated tests and integrate them into CI pipelines for regression and release testing.

• Conduct performance tests for data-heavy scenarios and report the results.

• Perform regression and release testing across different environments.

• Investigate issues using logs, report bugs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes.

• Take part in requirement reviews and help define acceptance criteria.

• Maintain test documentation (test plans, test cases, checklists, reports) and suggest process improvements.

• Support junior QA engineers when needed.

Skills & Qualifications:
Must Have

• Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, test planning and test case design.

• Good SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools).

• Programming experience in Python, Java or JavaScript for test automation (Python preferred).

• Experience with test automation and running tests in CI pipelines.

• Familiarity with Linux, version control (Git) and issue tracking tools (JIRA).

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with data pipelines, databases or big data tools (e.g., Airflow, Trino, Spark).

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

• UI test automation experience (Playwright, Selenium or similar).

• Familiarity with Python data tools such as pandas or Jupyter.

• Interest in engineering simulation software such as ABAQUS, ANSYS or

• COMSOL, and familiarity with High Performance Computing (HPC).

• ISTQB or other relevant certifications.

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for an Principal Software Development Engineer (Layer 7 Security & Proxy) to join our team. This is a hybrid role (minimum 3 days a week in Santa Clara, CA office), reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. This architect role is essential to provide technical leadership for the ZIA proxy architecture, with a strong focus on advanced Layer 7 protocols and SSL inspection. You will help improve the quality of code shipped to production by driving sound architectural decisions, implementing innovative solutions, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team. Additionally, you will play a key role in modernizing the ZIA code base by addressing technical debt, fixing existing issues, and rewriting components where necessary. Ultimately, this role is critical for supporting and accelerating the delivery of key proxy roadmap features on a strong and scalable foundation.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

• Support end-to-end QUIC/HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 proxy and TLS/SSL architecture in ZIA

• Define and evolve ZIA proxy architecture

• Partner with Product Management and engineering on solution design, trade-offs, and end-to-end delivery of core ZIA functionality

• Establish reference architectures and design patterns for ZIA components and integrations

• Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural governance across virtual and product teams

• You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

• You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external users while anchoring your decisions in solving real-world problems.

• You are driven by innovation, bringing deep curiosity to complex technical challenges and constantly seeking better, more secure, and scalable solutions.

• You think at scale, connecting your daily work to the larger mission to build solutions that support a high-growth, global organization.

• You lead with integrity by holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and building trust through consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 12 + years of experience of total experience and proven experience in designing and implementing networking security software and public clouds infrastructure

• Deep understanding of Proxies, HTTP/2, QUIC, TCP/IP, TLS/DTLS and SSL proxies

• Proficient in C language

• Demonstrated success in designing, optimizing, and troubleshooting high-throughput, low-latency network security products

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Technical Consulting is Ramp's post-sales technical delivery team. When a finance org needs Ramp to work the way their business actually runs, this is the team that takes customers through that transformation, from complex accounting issues to integration errors to everything in between.

The Senior Manager, Technical Consulting, Strategic leads the team responsible for Ramp's largest and most strategic accounts. You'll own post-sales technical implementation for this segment end to end - from technical discovery and solution design through go-live, adoption, and expansion - working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Customer Activation team, with whom you'll co-own activation milestones and time-to-value.

Strategic customers arrive with multi-entity structures, legacy ERPs, in-flight finance transformations, procurement and treasury requirements, and executive sponsors who expect a named technical leader in the room. Your team is the last line of technical escalation for these accounts - there is no tier above you.

This role suits an experienced leader who can hold two things at once: the operating rigor to run a delivery function at scale, and the technical credibility to sit across from a Controller or VP of Finance and design the solution live.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead and grow the Strategic Technical Consulting team - coach senior and principal-level consultants, own hiring, onboarding, performance, and career architecture, and build a bench deep enough to scale with the segment

- Own post-sales technical implementation for Ramp's largest accounts - accountable for solution quality, delivery timelines, and technical outcomes across the portfolio

- Co-own activation milestones with Customer Activation - build a joint operating model where TC drives technical design and Activation drives adoption and enablement, with shared accountability for time-to-value and a single, coherent customer experience

- Serve as the terminal escalation point for complex technical and delivery challenges - ERP integration failures, custom API work, at-risk go-lives, and commitments made pre-sales that need to be re-scoped

- Define the Strategic delivery model - scoping standards, solution design review, rules of engagement with CSM/Activation, staffing and capacity models, and quality bars that hold up under enterprise scrutiny

- Run the function with operational rigor - forecast capacity, balance workload across accounts, instrument the team with KPIs (time-to-value, go-live on-time rate, escalation volume, adoption and expansion attach), and use the data in coaching and planning

- Partner cross-functionally at the leadership level - Customer Activation, Strategic CSM and AM, Sales, Product, Engineering, and GTM Ops - to align on roadmap, feedback loops, and segment strategy

- Turn field insight into product influence - synthesize what Strategic customers actually need, champion it with Product and Engineering, and close the loop back to the field

- Set precedent where none exists - make sound calls
